$comment: Edit this file, not the code. Run `npm run doctor` after changing tiers to verify every model slug resolves against the live provider.
$comment_requiredEnv: Environment the PROJECT needs, not what Trellis needs. Checked by `trellis doctor` and by setup --probe, so a missing key surfaces before a run instead of at node 40. Entries are either "NAME" or { "name": "NAME", "why": "what it is for" }. Example: [{ "name": "GITHUB_TOKEN", "why": "read-only, no scopes — never a PAT with repo scope" }]

budget.$comment: Run-level ceilings. Null disables one. On breach the runner stops LAUNCHING, lets in-flight nodes finish, and leaves the rest for --resume.

routing.$comment: Ledger-driven tier selection. Inert until minObservations of a tag/tier pair exist, then skips leading tiers that historically fail it.

verify.$comment: mutationsOnPass runs each node's declared mutations against the accepted code. onSurvivor: 'warn' merges and flags; 'hold' keeps it unmerged. requirePrecondition makes `trellis run` refuse to start if any node's frozen tests changed since `trellis verify-tests` last proved them non-vacuous against a null stub — set false to restore the old behavior (verify-tests as an optional command), or pass --skip-verify to run once without changing the config. structuralMutants runs a mechanical, zero-token sweep of comparison/logical/boolean-literal flips against every node's implementation, in addition to (not instead of) any LLM-authored `mutations` in the graph, capped at structuralMutantLimit per node. proposeOnSurvivor writes a held-for-human proposal under evolution/proposals/ whenever a mutant survives, rather than leaving that evidence sitting only in state.json.

driver.$comment: Autonomous session chaining. OFF by default — read sessions/README.md before enabling. There is no API for remaining subscription quota, so the driver never predicts whether the next session fits; it runs, verifies on disk, and backs off. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to get documented limits and retryable 429s instead of opaque subscription caps.

evolve.$comment: Self-improvement stays inert until the same structured rejection code appears in minRuns distinct runs. autoApply governs advisory prose only; load-bearing changes always wait for a human merge, and protected paths are never proposable at all.

headers.$comment: OpenRouter uses these for attribution. Harmless elsewhere.

gate.$stripEnv: Environment variables removed before the gate command runs. Tier apiKeyEnv names are stripped automatically; add anything else the project must not expose to code a worker just wrote.

sandbox.$comment: Best-effort resource containment for gate commands, via the POSIX shell's ulimit — not an isolation boundary, and not enforced on Windows (trellis doctor warns either way). Off by default; enable once you've read kit/lib/sandbox.mjs's docblock on what it does and does not bound.

boundaries.$comment: Paths no worker may ever write, regardless of what the graph node allows. Matched case-insensitively, because .GIT/config and KIT/lib/gate.mjs open the real files on Windows and macOS.
boundaries.$gate-config: The second half of this list is the file a gate command reads. A worker that can write package.json decides what `npm test` runs; conftest.py executes before every pytest; a Makefile target is whatever it says. Denied at every depth, not just the root, because a monorepo package carries its own. If a node genuinely must change one, that is a human's edit, not a worker's. This list is enumerated per-ecosystem rather than closed-form on purpose -- a config-shaped file this list omits is a route around the frozen-test guarantee, so widen it as fast as new test runners get adopted, not only when one is caught being exploited.
